cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before your caretaker interview, apologise to that chair. You sat without its consent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then tell it you're sorry for taking silence as permission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, chair. I'll stand for the interview.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for making it redundant. You're applying to care for furniture, and your first solution is to leave it without a job.

mechanism: A uses interview authority to demand apologies to a chair for both sitting without consent and depriving it of work.
confusable: Unlike ordinary politeness training, the object is assigned impossible consent and employment expectations that A enforces.
comparison: A caretaker interview tests how B treats furniture, unlike an inn doorway's impossible advance notice.
seedUse: The seed already orders and revises the apology and judges caretaker suitability, giving S01 a specific authority relation.
